{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
trial_df_clean = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute the response rate within each severity stratum
response_by_stratum = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the difference in response rates within each severity stratum
response_diff_by_stratum = response_by_stratum.loc['treatment'] - response_by_stratum.loc['control']

# Check if the treatment arm has worse severity distribution
severity_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the proportion of each severity level in each arm
prop_by_arm = severity_by_arm.div(severity_by_arm.sum(axis=1), axis=0)

# Print results
print("Proportion of severity by arm:\n", prop_by_arm)

# Check the overall response rate difference
response_rate_control = response_by_stratum.loc['control'].mean()
response_rate_treatment = response_by_stratum.loc['treatment'].mean()

print("Overall response rate - control:", response_rate_control)
print("Overall response rate - treatment:", response_rate_treatment)
print("Difference (treatment - control):", response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control)"}
